definitions.explanation: the early part of winter, typically referring to November to early December in Japan

examples.japanese: {初冬|しょとう}の{寒|さむ}さが{身|み}にしみる。
examples.english: The early winter cold pierces the body.

examples.japanese: {初冬|しょとう}には{紅葉|こうよう}がまだ{残|のこ}っている。
examples.english: In early winter, the autumn leaves are still lingering.

examples.japanese: {初冬|しょとう}の{候|こう}、{皆様|みなさま}いかがお{過|す}ごしでしょうか。
examples.english: In this early winter season, how is everyone doing?

notes:
COMPOUND:
{初|しょ} (beginning/first) + {冬|とう} (winter)

TIME FRAME:
Typically refers to November to early December in Japan, when autumn transitions to winter.

FORMAL GREETINGS:
{初冬|しょとう}の{候|こう} is used in formal letters and correspondence during early winter.

SEASONAL DIVISIONS ({季語|きご}):
Japanese traditionally divides winter ({冬|ふゆ}) into:
- {初冬|しょとう} - early winter (November)
- {仲冬|ちゅうとう} - mid-winter (December)
- {晩冬|ばんとう} - late winter (January)

RELATED SEASONAL TERMS:
- {晩秋|ばんしゅう} - late autumn
- {厳冬|げんとう} - severe winter
- {真冬|まふゆ} - midwinter
